title: Domain Architect
description:
**Job Description**
 You will be the cloud domain architect and and lead the design and evolution of
 **Openshift, cloud and large\-scale Kubernetes\-based platforms** 
 , working at the intersection of architecture, engineering, and strategy.
   

  

 This role goes beyond defining solutions — you will
 **drive how platforms are built, scaled, and operated** 
 , partnering closely with engineering teams while influencing key technical decisions across domains.
   

  

 You’ll play a central role in pushing forward a
 **Kubernetes\-first, cloud\-native vision** 
 , ensuring systems meet the highest standards of
 **resilience, scalability, and performance** 
 , while remaining pragmatic and production\-ready.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Own and drive the architecture of Openshift, Kubernetes\-based platforms, from design to real\-world production
* Translate complex business and product needs into clear, scalable technical solutions (HLD/LLD)
* Set direction and best practices across cloud\-native, containerized environments
* Act as a technical leader, influencing decisions and guiding engineering teams
* Support teams on implementation, optimization, and troubleshooting in production
* Continuously improve platform capabilities across CI/CD, observability, and security, ISTIO


**Key Skills And Experience**
* Senior\-level architect with strong experience designing and running cloud\-native distributed systems at scale, with deep expertise in Openshift, Docker and Kubernetes in production environments
* Combines hands\-on technical depth with strategic thinking, comfortable in complex environments where performance, reliability, and scalability are critical
* Strong expertise in Kubernetes, containers, and cloud\-native architectures, hands on experience in Openshift with troubleshooting knowledge, ISTIO
* Experience with distributed systems and microservices at scale
* Solid understanding of CI/CD (ideally GitOps), Linux, networking, and security
* Proven ability to influence technical decisions and lead through expertise
* Exposure to telecom platforms, service mesh, observability tools, or infrastructure as code is a plus


**About Us**

title: Solution Services Domain Architect
description:
**Job Description**
 We are seeking a talented and experienced Solution Services Domain Architect to join our team. This role is responsible for building and maintaining full\-stack service labs, which includes integrating various cloud platforms and applications. The architect will design and implement end\-to\-end test setups that mimic customer architectures, ensuring seamless vertical and horizontal integration. Additionally, they will lead the execution of functional, regression, upgrade, stability, performance, and interoperability tests, developing automated test scripts to streamline the testing process.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Design and maintain full\-stack service labs, integrating applications, networks, and cloud platforms.
* Ensure vertical and horizontal integration across diverse cloud platforms and applications.
* Lead the execution of end\-to\-end test setups, matching NAM customer architectures and gold standards.
* Deploy and maintain automation infrastructure, including pipelines, tools, and scripts.
* Build and manage shared cloud lab environments, providing on\-demand access to domains.
* Keep labs stable, secure, and user\-friendly, ensuring optimal performance and security.
* Automate lab creation, teardown, and maintenance processes, reducing manual effort.
* Utilize scripts, pipelines, and APIs to minimize manual work and enhance efficiency.
* Lead the development of test scripts for automated testing, improving test coverage and speed.
* Track test progress, resolve issues, and validate results against requirements, delivering comprehensive validation reports.


**Key Skills And Experience**
 Must have:
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in software development, cloud computing, or a similar field.
* Knowledge of K8s and openstack cloud platforms, networking, and Nokia Core and BA application integration.
* Experience with Nokia automation tools, pipelines, and scripting languages.
* Proficiency in designing and implementing end\-to\-end test strategies.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills, with a focus on attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.


 Good to have:
   

  

* Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, for collaborating with cross\-functional teams.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and industry trends.
* A proactive and innovative mindset, driving continuous improvement.

title: MS Specialist Core
description:
**Job Description**
 Nokia Global Delivery operations comprise the NOC Operations (FCAPS) for the global telecom companies from all market segments. CSPs and Enterprise customers are served from the Nokia GDC. This Role will be responsible for end\-to\-end handling of network operations. Providing technical consultation and resolving queries/service tickets/incidents.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Providing technical support for complex Core nodes (Analysis, Troubleshooting \& fixing the issues reported) on already deployed to end customer/user.
* Technical Operations support for Customer Team.
* Manages technical escalations for technical requests, emergency cases and outages internally and towards customer.
* Support customer’s network performance and evolution.
* Manages network SW and HW configuration information.
* Acts as the prime technical interface towards customer, subcontractors and 3rd party suppliers as well as internally towards several organizations.
* Liaise closely with Multiple teams to work on the operation faults and technical management to ensure the Network stability.
* Monitors and reports customer’s life network performance and acts to ensure network’s availability including e.g. customer SLA fulfilment
* Support and perform competence development of local technical teams.
* Ensure multiple network Element are connected and all functions are working well.
* Handling Critical and Emergency network incidents with stakeholders/Care.


**Key Skills And Experience**
**Must\-Have:**
* Typically, a minimum experience on Platforms between 7\-10 yrs require
* Require Educational Qualification B.E/B.Tech.
* In\-depth understanding of OpenStack Architecture NFV, Mano \& its components like (component like Nova, Cinder, Neutron, Horizon, Glance, Keystone)
* Live experience in deploying / managing the Cloud Infra using OpenStack.
* System Administration of Linux ubuntu/OpenStack environment
* Storage knowledge like HP, EMC and IBM LUN creation and allocation
* Service deployment using the Virtualization, Orchestration, Image


**Nice\-To\-Have:**
* Linux distributions: Ubuntu, Centos, Red hat New installation and trouble shoot.
* Storage knowledge like HP, EMC and IBM LUN creation and allocation
* Understanding of SDN and VLAN and overlay (VXLAN, MPLSGRE etc.)

title: Customer Solutions Architect
description:
**Job Description**
 The Domain Architect is responsible for defining and implementing the Core domain\-wide strategy for Application(Cloud network function) deployment automation and AI\-enabled Automation SW development and delivery across various Nokia blueprint as well as customized product teams. The role requires deep expertise in cloud\-native technologies, Network function deployment automation frameworks, CI/CD ecosystems, and the application of AI capabilities to optimize development workstreams, operational efficiency and delivery velocity. The architect will drive scalable, maintainable automation solutions, enable self\-healing delivery pipelines, and mentor teams in modern DevOps and AI\-assisted SW engineering practices.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Lead requirement analysis, solution alignment, and end\-to\-end architecture activities, including HLD, LLD, CIQ validation and solution governance.
* Define migration strategies, provide technical leadership, and guide implementation activities across the complete migration lifecycle.
* Drive customization discussions, RCA execution, escalation management, and resolution of technical issues in collaboration with Care, R\&D and cross\-functional teams.
* Lead architecture workshops, design reviews, technical documentation, knowledge transfer, and delivery readiness activities to ensure successful solution deployment and adoption.
* Promote innovation through automation, AI\-driven solutions, next\-generation delivery practices, and close collaboration with R\&D/Development team on product enhancements.


**Key Skills And Experience**
 Must Have
   

  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or a related field, with 10\+ years of experience in architecting software, IT, or telecom solutions.
* Exhibit extensive hands\-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, containerized application deployments.
* Proven experience in defining Cloud\-native architectures and delivering those solutions to the market.
* Experience working effectively in global organizations, with strong communication, motivational and technical leadership skills.
* Prior design and application deployment experience in custom solution and applications products.


 Nice\-to\-Have:
   

  

* Telecom domain exposure (Packet Core, 4G/5G, network protocols, cloud\-native network functions) and Experience in implementing autonomous deployment platforms or AI\-driven operational automation.
* Knowledge of MLOps, AI platform operations and deployment of AI/ML workloads in cloud\-native environments and Certifications in cloud platforms or AI/ML specialties
